keywords: EIP-8224 反事实交易用 ZK 证明为新地址私密支付 gas
比特币无需软分叉的量子安全交易
summary: 周日。benaadams 提交 EIP-8224，新增 `0x08` 类型的“反事实交易”，用针对规范手续费票据合约的 ZK 证明为没有 ETH 的新 EOA 支付 gas，避免入金暴露关联。prestwich 提交 EIP-8164 的配套提案，让 ECRECOVER 预编译感知原生密钥委托。StarkWare 讨论无需软分叉的比特币量子安全交易。

items.topic: 隐私与 gas：反事实交易
items.title: 新 EIP：Counterfactual Transaction（EIP-8224）
items.note: （benaadams）提交：新增 EIP-2718 交易类型 `0x08`，利用针对规范手续费票据（fee-note）合约的 ZK 证明，在协议层为交易提供隐蔽的 gas 资金；Magicians 讨论帖 08:33。
items.note_en: (benaadams), submitted: a new EIP-2718 transaction type `0x08` for protocol native shielded gas funding using ZK proofs against canonical fee note contracts; Magicians discussion, 08:33.

items.title: 新 EIP：ECRECOVER 感知原生密钥
items.note: （prestwich）提交：作为 EIP-8164（EOA 原生密钥委托）的配套，修改地址 `0x01` 的 ECRECOVER 预编译；恢复出的地址若已有原生密钥委托（`0xef01` 加非零字节），则返回空，防止合约继续接受已弃用的 ECDSA 密钥签名。
items.title_en: New EIP: ECRECOVER native key awareness
items.note_en: (prestwich), submitted: a companion to EIP-8164 (native key delegation for EOAs) that changes the ECRECOVER precompile at `0x01`; if the recovered address has a native key delegation (`0xef01` plus a nonzero byte) it returns empty, so contracts stop accepting signatures from the retired ECDSA key.

keywords_en: EIP-8224 counterfactual transactions fund gas privately with ZK proofs
quantum safe Bitcoin transactions without softforks
summary_en: A Sunday. benaadams submitted EIP-8224, a `0x08` "counterfactual transaction" that uses ZK proofs against canonical fee note contracts to pay gas for a fresh EOA with no ETH, so funding it does not reveal a link. prestwich submitted a companion to EIP-8164 making the ECRECOVER precompile aware of native key delegation. StarkWare discussed quantum safe Bitcoin transactions without softforks.
